description: Source code for a module implementing uline functionality in a scripting environment, including state management, input handling, and integration with uloop event loop.

classes.name: uc_uline_state
classes.description: Represents the state of a uline session, including file descriptors, buffers, and callback references.

classes.name: uc_arg_parser
classes.description: Holds configuration for argument parsing, specifically line separator character.

methods.name: registry_set
methods.description: Adds a value to the uline registry and returns its index.

methods.name: uc_uline_poll
methods.description: Polls for input and returns the current line buffer.

methods.name: uc_uline_poll_key
methods.description: Waits for a key press with optional timeout and returns the pressed key.

methods.name: uc_uline_poll_stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing polling.

methods.name: uc_uline_get_window
methods.description: Returns the current window size as an object.

methods.name: uc_uline_get_line
methods.description: Retrieves the current line and cursor position.

methods.name: uc_uline_set_state
methods.description: Sets the internal state of the uline session based on provided object.

methods.name: uc_uline_set_hint
methods.description: Sets a hint string for the uline prompt.

methods.name: uc_uline_set_uloop
methods.description: Associates a uloop callback for event-driven input.

methods.name: uc_uline_reset_key_input
methods.description: Resets the key input mask.

methods.name: uc_uline_hide_prompt
methods.description: Hides the prompt.

methods.name: uc_uline_refresh_prompt
methods.description: Refreshes the prompt display.

methods.name: uc_uline_new
methods.description: Creates a new uline session with specified configuration.

methods.name: free_state
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a uline state.

methods.name: uc_uline_close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a uline session.

methods.name: uc_uline_arg_parser
methods.description: Creates an argument parser resource with specified options.

methods.name: uc_uline_argp_parse
methods.description: Parses command-line style arguments.

methods.name: uc_uline_argp_check
methods.description: Checks argument parsing without side effects.

methods.name: uc_uline_argp_escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe command-line usage.

methods.name: uc_uline_getpass
methods.description: Prompts for a password input without echo.
